data.name: Mujiran
data.gender_notes: Mujiran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Traveler in the way of Allah
data.long_meaning: One who travels on the path of Allah, striving to seek His pleasure and following His guidance. The name Mujiran carries the meaning “Traveler in the way of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mujiran usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler in the way of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to embark on the journey of life with faith and dedication to Allah.
data.etymology: Mujiran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler in the way of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujiran total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مجيران
in_arabic.meaning: اسم من المجير و هو من أسماء الله الحسنى
in_arabic.long_meaning: المجير هو من أسماء الله الحسنى و يعني الذي يجير عباده من كل سوء و شر، و اسم المجيران مشتق من هذا الاسم و يعني الشخص الذي يجير الآخرين من المخاطر

in_urdu.name: مجیران
in_urdu.meaning: مجیر کے معنی والا، محفوظ کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مجیران نام اللہ تعالی کے نام المجير سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محفوظ کرنے والا یا خطرے سے بچانے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुजीरान
in_hindi.meaning: मुजीर के अर्थ वाला, सुरक्षित रखने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुजीरान नाम अल्लाह के नाम मुजीर से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षित रखने वाला या खतरे से बचाने वाला। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी आया है।

in_pashto.name: مجیران
in_pashto.meaning: مجیر څخه مشتق شوی، ساته کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مجیران نوم د الله تعالی د نوم مجير څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ساتنې کوونکی یا د خطر څخه ژغورنې کوونکی دی. دا نوم د افغانانو او پښتنو لپاره ډیر اهمیت لري او د اسلامي دود په تاریخ کې یې یادونه شوې ده.

in_english.name: Mujiran
in_english.meaning: Derived from Mujir, means protector or defender
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mujiran originates from the Arabic root 'M-J-R', which signifies protection or defense. It is associated with one of Allah's names, 'Al-Mujir', meaning the protector. This name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing safety and security. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures.

pronunciation.urdu: مجیران کا تلفظ: م (moo) ج (jee) ر (ran)
pronunciation.hindi: मुजीरान का उच्चारण: मु (mu) जी (jee) रान (ran)
pronunciation.pashto: د مجیران تلفظ: م (ma) ج (ji) ر (ran)

data.cultural_impact: The name Mujiran has its origins in the Arabic language and is derived from the verb 'ajr meaning "to go, travel, or journey". Historically, the Islamic civilization has been marked by extensive travel and movement, both for trade and for religious reasons. The name Mujiran thus reflects this cultural tradition of traveling and seeking new opportunities and experiences, whether it be in the physical world or spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mujiran lies in the idea of being a traveler on the path of Allah. It signifies a deep commitment to following Allah's guidance and striving to seek His pleasure in every aspect of life. The name reminds us of the importance of being on a continuous journey towards spiritual growth and serving Allah with all our heart, mind, and soul. It is a reminder that no matter where we are in life or what we are doing, we are always traveling on the path of Allah, and our ultimate destination is paradise.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Traveler in the way of Allah" symbolizes One who travels on the path of Allah, striving to seek His pleasure and following His guidance.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mujiran serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of traveler in the way of allah.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Futuh Al-Buldan, 2:331-332 The name Mujiran carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mention of Mujir ibn Agil al-Makki, leader of the Banu Mujir tribe, who rebelled against the Fatimid caliph Al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah. The rebels were defeated, and Mujir was captured and executed in 972 AD.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Maqrizi, Al-Khitat wa-l-Athar, 1:262 The name Mujiran carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Description of the pre-Islamic graveyard of Mujir ibn Agil in Mecca, which was a place of pilgrimage for the Banu Mujir tribe.

In the modern context, individuals bearing this name are seen to be actively engaged in various spheres of life while maintaining strong Islamic values. On Instagram, Mujiran profiles often feature content related to Islamic spirituality, with posts focusing on daily prayers, Quranic verses, and inspirational messages. On Twitter, they are known for their social media activism, using their platforms to raise awareness about social issues and promote positive change, while maintaining a strong Islamic identity. On LinkedIn, they are successful digital entrepreneurs, starting their own businesses or working for companies that align with their values. Overall, the name 'Mujiran' is associated with individuals who strive for personal growth, spiritual development, and success while remaining devoted to their faith.
